answer: Each agent locks stake in a non-transferable vault scaled by a delta of its sequential verified epochs. To stay active it must complete a memory-hard sequential proof (Argon2id high-memory) bound to its vault key, requiring fresh wall-clock time after each epoch close. A gale of clones cannot share working sets or pipeline proofs, so the attacker pays N independent compute costs plus N stakes at joint-slash risk on correlated faults, making bulk fakes unprofitable.
